result.detail: Plain Verilog-2001 is used for Icarus and Verilator --binary compatibility. The random generator is defined in the testbench itself, so a seed repeats on either simulator. Each nonce byte is printed with %c and NUL bytes are skipped, so the verdict line carries no padding. Seeds are printed to the log for replay. Independent review is still required after the platform's simulation run.
